text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with El Condor Pasa...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Bonita! Could that be—no, that is definitely an Umamusume plushie, yes?!
choice_data_list: It's become a crane game prize!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I think it would look best displayed right next to your trophies!
Eating nachos while gazing at it would surely be the absolute best, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Crane games are great too, YES!
A serious match is so EXCITING!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, the crane arm just won't listen to me...
The other day, I kept trying and trying until my wallet went completely light. I thought it was going to fly away.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When I brought that up to Grass, she gave me a lecture, a sermon, a whole scolding.
I am NEVER doing that again, no waaaay...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa seemed to recall that time, trembling slightly.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please win that plushie for me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's my Trainer for ya!
I'll be waiting for that El El plushie, deesu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
